angles: The enterprise AI adoption gap: 78% of Fortune 500 have AI in production but only 5% see measurable returns — adoption does not equal value
The two-speed market: GitHub Copilot dominates large enterprises (56% in 10K+ companies) while Claude Code and Cursor lead startups — different tools for different scale
The productivity paradox: High adoption (90%) coexists with low trust (29%) and measured slowdowns (METR 19% slower on complex tasks)
The tool stack explosion: 70% of developers use 2-4 AI tools simultaneously — enterprise tool management is becoming the next IT challenge
From adoption to governance: AI-generated code produces 10,000+ security findings/month — enterprise adoption demands security frameworks
The structural shift: Developers now spend 11.4 hours/week reviewing AI-generated code vs 9.8 hours writing new code — a role reversal from 2024
Shadow AI risk: 38% of employees share confidential data with unapproved AI systems — enterprise adoption must address IT governance
The ROI challenge: 95% of GenAI pilots show zero P&L impact; structured rollouts achieve 47% gains vs 12% for ad hoc
